Dismantling the myth of the 'epistemological break'
Orthodox / Soviet Marxism
Believes in a total break' in
Marx's thought in 1845.
Dismisses the "Young Marx" as
a soft philosopher.
Views Capital as a purely economic,
structuralist, and deterministic text.
Historically resulted in dogmatic
state bureaucracy.
Dussel's Philosophy of Liberation
Proves absolute continuity from
his youth to his death.
Views Marx fundamentally as a
philosopher of ethics and life.
Reads Capital as an ethical critique
of a system that destroys
human corporeality.
Dussel spent 15 years reading Marx line-by-line, including unedited
manuscripts from Amsterdam, to prove this absolute continuity.

The foundation of critique is the vulnerable human body
Against Hegel
Hegel believed reality was pure self-consciousness.
Marx recognized that the true meaning of 'material'
is the physical, cosmic reality of the body.
Leiblichkeit (Corporeality)
The real human being with feet on
the earth.
Leidendes (Suffering)
To be living is to be vulnerable. Basic natural
necessities -eating, drinking, clothing,
housing-are the absolute preconditions for
any economy.

Capital operates as a vampire feeding on living vitality
Lebendigkeit (Vitality)
Human energy, consciousness,
and the biological capacity to create.
Dead Labor
The accumulated
machinery of Capital.
Capital is dead labor that,
vampire-like, only lives by
sucking living labor.
For Marx, economics is a dialectic of life and death.
The worker does not just sell time; they objectify and sacrifice
their actual biological lifespan into the product.

The fetishism of the market
as an altar of human sacrifice
- The Inversion
Fetishism occurs when the
creations of human hands are
worshipped as absolute laws,
while actual human beings are
treated as disposable objects.
- Mammon & Moloch
Marx repeatedly used these
theological names for the God of
Money. Moloch was an ancient
deity satisfied only by the
sacrifice of human life.
- The Ethical Core
Capital demands the literal
starvation of the poor to maintain
the 'invisible hand'. It functions
as an anti-life religion
masquerading as a
natural science.

500 years of extraction inevitably produces two fatal crises
The Destruction of the Earth
Capital views nature (Pachamama) merely
as a free resource with no exchange value,
leading to ecological collapse.
1492
The logic of endlessly increasing the profit rate
inherently destroys its two absolute sources of Present
wealth: the earth and the worker.
The Destruction of Humanity
Capital produces structural exclusion. The
majority of humanity is pushed entirely
outside the market, leading to mass poverty.
